title: Where and when the water suits a fish with temperature and food limits
query: A pelagic fish is assumed to need a sea surface temperature between 12 and 16 C and a surface chlorophyll concentration between 0.2 and 3 mg/m3. Using the supplied GLORYS12 daily near-surface temperature and CMEMS biogeochemical reanalysis monthly chlorophyll for 1993-2020 off California and Oregon (30-48 N, 130-116 W), determine where and when such habitat exists, how its area and position move through the year and from year to year, which of the two conditions limits it where, and how sensitive the answer is to the two ranges and to combining a daily product with a monthly one. The two products come from different model systems; account for that.
